name: THE ORDINARY VITAMIN C SUSPENSION 23% + HA SPHERES 2% 30 ML/1 FL.OZ. SEALED NIB
description:
Vitamin C Suspension 23% in HA Spheres uses direct vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to help visibly reduce signs of aging by brightening and balancing uneven skin tone. This water-free formulation provides 23% pure L-Ascorbic Acid, which remains completely stable due to the absence of water. What’s more, this water-free formulation is supported with spheres of hyaluronic acid for added hydration.

Note: The slightly granular texture of this product is due to the vitamin C powder being suspended in an oil-like base and therefore each application requires a few seconds to feel absorbed by the skin. If desired, this formula can be diluted in a cream base per application to allow the skin to build tolerance over time.
